editorial.blurb: A beloved Cantonese dim sum and noodle spot in Chicago's Chinatown that earns authentic cred from its largely Chinese clientele and consistently delicious, generously portioned dishes.
editorial.insiderTip: Come hungry and order multiple dim sum dishes to share—portions are genuinely huge, so 9 dishes easily feeds two people. Ask your server for recommendations; the deep fried taro and pan fried chow mein with beef and Gai Lan are standouts.
signatureDishes: Cantonese pan fried chow mein with beef and Gai Lan
